transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to see me?

Well, I guess what brings me in is... I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's really just a cup of coffee and maybe a piece of bread. And, well, I've noticed my pants are just hanging loose on me lately.
Are you intentionally cutting back on food in an effort to lose weight?

No, it's not about trying to lose weight at all. I just... I don't have the appetite for it. Like I said, I'll just have coffee and a piece of bread, and that's it for the day. I'm not doing it on purpose, I just don't feel like eating, and then I noticed my clothes were getting really baggy.
Along with the loss of appetite, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days I wake up with this... this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It just feels like there's nothing good waiting for me out there, you know? I just want to keep my head down.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say it's been about five months now. This whole depressed spell has just been hanging over me for that long.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, where you felt depressed like this for weeks or months?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, sure, but... nothing like this. Not where it just stays for months and I can't shake it. This is the first time it's been this bad.
Did something specific happen or change in your life around five months ago before these feelings started?

No, I don't think so. I've actually thought about that a lot, trying to figure out why this happened, but... nothing really comes to mind. There wasn't any big event or change right before it started. It just sort of... showed up and stayed.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things and activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really like going for walks down by the lake, or just sitting and working on my little model kits. But now... they just sit there. I look at them and it's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just don't have any drive to do them anymore.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy during this time?

Yeah. All the time. Just... doing anything is hard right now. Even taking out the trash, or just getting myself here to the clinic today, it feels like it's just too much. I don't know, it's like my arms and legs are just full of wet sand. They're just so heavy.
How has your sleep been during these past few months?

It hasn't been good. Lately, I either just... lie there for hours staring at the wall, or I end up waking up way before the sun even comes up and I just can't get back to sleep. And honestly, even when I do manage to get some sleep, I still wake up feeling completely worn out.
During this time, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing you were no longer here?
No, I haven't. I mean, I feel terrible, and everything is just... exhausting right now. But I don't want to hurt myself. I don't wish I was dead or anything like that.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or focusing on things lately, like reading, watching television, or following conversations?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's been real bad lately. Like, if I try to look at forms or pay a bill, my brain just won't stay on it. I can't keep my mind focused. And it's even just dumb stuff, too. I'll be standing in the grocery store, just staring at the shelves, and I get completely stuck trying to figure out which can of soup to buy. I just can't decide.
